newsitem.title: USA: GPU sees 850 Penn. coal unit operating Sat.
newsitem.headline: GPU sees 850 Penn. coal unit operating Sat.

text.p: GPU Generation Inc expected its 850 megawatt (MW) Keystone 2 coal-fired unit near Johnstown, Pa., to return to service Saturday after being shut early Thursday due to a boiler tube leak, the company said.
"It'll return August 31," said company spokeswoman Jane Oleksak, adding the adjoining Keystone unit 1, also 850 MW, was running at full output.

The Keystone plant is jointly owned by seven companies, including Baltimore Gas and Electric Co, Delmarva Power and Light Co, PP&L Resources subsidiary Pennsylvnaia Power and Light Co and PECO Energy Co.
GPU Generation is a subsidary of GPU Inc. of Parsippany, N.J.
